FamilyProfile.title: FamilyProfile
FamilyProfile.description: Synchronized family directory entry storing Name, Family ID (FN), Father Name, and Address for automatic cascading dropdowns.

name.description: Primary person or family head name.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when last updated (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

ActivityRecord.title: ActivityRecord
ActivityRecord.description: Daily activity, event, Neondra ledger, home items, and reminder record.

familyDocId.description: Optional linked FamilyProfile document ID for bidirectional sync.

eventType.description: Event or activity category (e.g., شادی, ولیمہ, میٹنگ).

eventDetail.description: Event detail (E-Detail), e.g., علی رضا بن رجب علی.

eventDateMillis.description: Event date and time in epoch milliseconds.

direction.description: Transaction / activity direction: IN or OUT.

homeItems.description: Home gifts, cash, sweets, clothes, or activity notes.

reminderEnabled.description: Whether a local reminder alarm is active.

reminderAtMillis.description: Epoch millis when reminder should fire (0 if disabled).

reminderMinutesBefore.description: Reminder offset in minutes before event time.

calendarSynced.description: Whether the user exported/synced this entry to device calendar.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when last updated (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/families/{familyDocId}.description: Per-user synchronized directory of family profiles (Name, FN, Father, Address).

/users/{userId}/activities/{activityId}.description: Per-user daily activities, event gifts, Neondra ledger entries, and reminders.
